item.title: Iran using children in security roles in war, reports and witnesses say
item.summary: An 11-year-old is reported to have been killed in an air strike while manning a checkpoint in Tehran.

item.title: Israel says it will keep control over part of southern Lebanon after war with Hezbollah ends
item.summary: Defence Minister Israel Katz also says houses in Lebanese villages near the Israeli border will be demolished.

item.title: Peacekeepers killed by roadside explosion in Lebanon, initial report finds
item.summary: The deaths of the two Indonesian nationals came less than a day after another UN peacekeeper - also Indonesian - was killed in Lebanon.

item.title: Judge temporarily halts construction of Trump's White House ballroom
item.summary: The Republican-appointed judge ruled that Trump was the "steward" of the White House, but not the "owner".

item.title: Asia's migrant workers debate if Gulf jobs are worth deadly risk of Iran war
item.summary: Iran's strikes on Gulf states have been especially hard for migrants who have long supported these economies to lift their families back home from poverty.

item.title: How Pakistan won over Trump to become an unlikely mediator in the Iran war
item.summary: Pakistan's role as intermediary in this conflict took many by surprise. But perhaps it shouldn't have.

item.title: Inside the cockpit of RAF tanker during defensive mission against Iranian drones
item.summary: Defence correspondent Jonathan Beale flies onboard a Royal Air Force Voyager as it refuels jets in the Middle East.

item.title: Long queues in Myanmar as Iran war fuel crisis deepens
item.summary: Drivers are queuing for hours at petrol stations in Myanmar as the Iran war continues to send shockwaves across the globe.

item.title: US journalist Shelly Kittleson kidnapped in Baghdad
item.summary: The US state department says a suspect in her abduction has ties to an Iran-backed militia group, Kataib Hezbollah.

item.title: How the US could try to seize Iran's Kharg Island
item.summary: Donald Trump has indicated he could send troops to take control of Iran's key oil export terminal.
